description: A shell script for testing various 'push.default' Git configurations and behaviors, including setup of bare repositories, push success/failure scenarios, and workflow variations.

methods.name: check_pushed_commit
methods.description: Checks that the latest commit on a local revision matches the remote revision output.

methods.name: test_push_success
methods.description: Tests that a push with a specified 'push.default' value succeeds.

methods.name: test_push_failure
methods.description: Tests that a push with a specified 'push.default' value fails.

methods.name: test_pushdefault_workflow
methods.description: Tests push behavior under different workflows (central, triangular) with specific 'push.default' settings.
